sections.title: Shrub and flowers
sections.text: Highbush blueberry is a deciduous, upright shrub, commonly around 1–2 m tall in cultivation. Its toothed leaves are followed by pendent clusters of small, white to pink urn-shaped flowers.

sections.title: Fruit and food
sections.text: The round berries ripen from green through reddish-purple to blue-black with a waxy bloom; they reach about 12 mm across. The ripe fruit is edible and widely eaten fresh or cooked. The plate shows the shrub, urn-shaped flowers and blue ripe berries.
